name: Liquid Viscous
description: 2D incompressible Navier-Stokes with vorticity confinement. Vorticity at the centre and its four neighbours now comes from ONE shared stencil (was five separate calls, each doing four filtered samples), the pressure solve genuinely relaxes instead of recomputing one value four times, and the audio vortices drift along continuous Lissajous paths instead of teleporting every 0.7 s. Dye is injected per FFT band. dataTextureA carries simulation state.

updatedParams.name: Viscosity
updatedParams.description: Velocity damping and dye dissipation rate.

updatedParams.name: Vorticity Confinement
updatedParams.description: Strength of the confinement force that keeps eddies from smearing out (maps to zoom_params.y).

updatedParams.name: Turbulence Injection
updatedParams.description: Gain on the three-octave cascade and the per-band dye emitters (maps to zoom_params.z).

updatedParams.name: Hue Shift
updatedParams.description: Rotates the dye/vorticity hue mapping (maps to zoom_params.w).
